plugins.name: goodvibes
plugins.description: DEPRECATED (v2.0-alpha): the monolithic v1 plugin is superseded by goodvibes-intel, goodvibes-analytics, and goodvibes-connect. Kept installable through the alpha so existing users keep a working setup; removed at v2.0. Comprehensive Claude Code plugin with agents, skills, tools, hooks, and MCP servers for full-stack development.

plugins.name: goodvibes-intel
plugins.description: Structure-aware code search/read + verified static analyzers (15 tools).

plugins.name: goodvibes-analytics
plugins.description: Token and cost analytics with a tmux TUI dashboard (7 tools).

plugins.name: goodvibes-connect
plugins.description: Registered HTTP and database access under an explicit trust boundary (3 tools).
